anomalies.description: A large group of people is engaged in violent unrest on a street, with police in high-visibility vests and riot gear attempting to control the situation. Individuals are seen running, pushing, and clashing; at least one person is on the ground being attended to or restrained while others surround them. The scene shows chaotic movement, physical confrontations, and active intervention by law enforcement, consistent with a riot.

Multiple individuals are engaged in mutual physical combat: punching, grappling, and shoving are visible. In frames f5–f9, at least two distinct pairs appear to be actively fighting, with one person falling to the ground (f5, f6) and others surrounding and striking.

A chaotic street confrontation involving multiple police officers in high-visibility vests and riot gear engaging with a crowd of civilians; individuals are running, pushing, and being restrained, with visible physical struggle and dispersal efforts.

A person is on the ground (visible in f11–f13), surrounded by several individuals who appear to be kicking or striking them while they are incapacitated. One individual is crouched over the prone person, suggesting targeted assault on a helpless victim.

Mutual physical combat observed between at least two individuals: one in dark clothing and another in a grey hoodie, with aggressive postures and contact evident in frames f3–f5, including swinging arms and close engagement.

Multiple officers are seen restraining and dragging a person lying on the ground (visible from f9 onward), with the individual appearing non-resisting and helpless while being pulled across pavement; this constitutes abuse of a subdued person.
A person in dark clothing jumps onto the roof of a parked police car and then kicks or strikes the driver-side window, causing visible damage.

A second individual (in plaid shirt and red cap) approaches the police car and raises an arm toward the first person, who is still on or near the vehicle; physical confrontation appears imminent or occurring.
The driver-side window of the police car is shattered, with glass debris visible; the attack on the vehicle is complete and the perpetrator has dismounted.
Multiple police officers engage in physical confrontation with a man wearing a black jacket and red/yellow hat; one officer appears to strike or push the man while others restrain him.
A person is on the ground while multiple individuals, including police, surround and appear to strike or press down on them; the individual on the ground shows no capacity to resist.

Large group of people (including civilians and police) engaged in chaotic, overlapping physical altercations; multiple individuals are seen pushing, grabbing, and falling; scene escalates into widespread disorder beyond a single fight.

A group of individuals, including several in dark uniforms (likely security or police), are engaged in a physical struggle at the building entrance. Multiple people are seen grappling, pushing, and restraining each other near the glass doors across frames f0–f8.

After the initial scuffle, multiple individuals disperse rapidly outside the building; some run while others appear to throw objects (e.g., frame f14 shows a person in orange cap mid-throwing motion). The chaotic movement, dispersal, and apparent object-throwing indicate collective violent unrest beyond a simple fight.

A group of individuals engages in coordinated destructive and disruptive behavior outside a building: one person throws an object (likely a rock or bottle) toward the glass entrance (f0–f4), followed by multiple individuals climbing over a metal fence (f7–f15), indicating collective violent unrest rather than isolated acts.
Multiple individuals engaged in mutual physical combat; police officers intervene with batons and shields while civilians grapple and strike each other.
A person is on the ground being struck by multiple individuals, including at least one officer, while unable to defend themselves — consistent with attacking a helpless victim.
Large-scale violent unrest: crowd surges, police deploy shields and batons, multiple people are knocked down or fleeing, objects appear thrown, and chaotic group clashes persist across the street.
